issues.description: The Rideable.messageOnRide method signature is inconsistent across artifacts: the problem statement and the template's Main expect messageOnRide() with no parameters, but the solution defines Rideable.messageOnRide(String equipment) and implements it in Pig and Seal with a String parameter. This parameter mismatch will prevent students from implementing the interface as specified in the problem and from compiling the provided example Main code that calls messageOnRide() without arguments.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the method signature across all artifacts. Preferred fix: change Rideable.messageOnRide to have no parameters (String messageOnRide()), and update Pig and Seal to implement messageOnRide() returning the required format (e.g., "Riding on Pig Doodle" / "Riding on Seal Clarabelle"). Ensure the template Main and problem description remain consistent with this signature. Alternatively, if the equipment parameter is intended, update the problem statement and template Main to require and call messageOnRide(String equipment).

issues.description: The problem statement and the template code define Rideable.messageOnRide() as a no-argument method, but the solution repository defines Rideable.messageOnRide(String equipment) (and the Pig/Seal implementations use this signature). This creates a direct API/signature mismatch: students following the problem/template will call r.messageOnRide() with no parameter (see template Main.java), which will not match the solution's interface and implementations. This inconsistency breaks the conceptual mapping for the same method and can cause compilation/runtime confusion.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Rideable API consistent across artifacts. Preferably change the solution to match the problem/template by updating Rideable.messageOnRide(String equipment) to messageOnRide() and adjust Pig and Seal implementations accordingly to return "Riding on [Animal Type] [name]" (no equipment parameter). Alternatively, if an equipment parameter is intended, update the problem statement and template examples to require and pass the equipment argument everywhere.
